title: Context compression: what your agent reads

facts.method: conceptual explainer; the reference short (a phone capture) is the lead for pacing and type system only
facts.limits: This short explains a mechanism, it does not benchmark one. No vendor number is claimed on screen that the source does not state.

verify_before_render: Every on-screen number is either the reference's own or absent

scenes.say: Your agent feels slow — and the model is not the reason.
Context compression runs first: logs, chunks and whole files get cut before any model sees your text.
So the reading happens upstream of the prompt, and it is measured before it is trimmed.
Same question, two doors. One reads everything, and one reads only what survived the cut.
Here is the honest part — the compression is lossy, and it decides what to drop without asking.
Which would you rather lose, a log line or the file the answer was in? Comment CUT and I'll pin the link.
